rows.id: online:Measured by the relay; typical value first, then the 95th percentile. Ping: round trip between the player and the relay. {slot0} Behind: how far the player’s game ran behind the match clock, their input delay included. {slot1} Quality is the worst of these and of reconnects, time offline and delayed orders. Offline: time disconnected before reconnecting. Delayed orders: orders that ran a tick later than asked.
rows.source: Measured by the relay; typical value first, then the 95th percentile. Ping: round trip between the player and the relay. {slot0} Behind: how far the player’s game ran behind the match clock, their input delay included. {slot1} Quality is the worst of these and of reconnects, time offline and delayed orders. Offline: time disconnected before reconnecting. Delayed orders: orders that ran a tick later than asked.
rows.target: रिलेद्वारे मोजलेले; प्रथम सामान्य मूल्य, नंतर ९५ वे पर्सेन्टाइल. पिंग: खेळाडू आणि रिले यांच्यातील येण्या-जाण्याचा प्रवास. {slot0} मागे: खेळाडूचा गेम मॅच क्लॉकच्या किती मागे चालला, त्यात त्यांच्या इनपुटमधील विलंबाचा समावेश आहे. {slot1} गुणवत्ता ही या सर्वांमध्ये आणि पुन्हा कनेक्ट होणे, ऑफलाइन वेळ आणि विलंबित आदेशांमध्ये सर्वात वाईट आहे. ऑफलाइन: पुन्हा कनेक्ट होण्यापूर्वी डिस्कनेक्ट झालेला वेळ. विलंबित आदेश: मागितलेल्या वेळेपेक्षा एका टिकने उशिरा पूर्ण झालेले आदेश.
